issues.display_title: Issue #1699: Clean up unused search page and associated dead code
issues.main_description_html:
Goal: Remove the search page and all associated dead code.

Analysis of Dead Code to Remove:

  1. Frontend UI (Search Component)
    • src/app/pages/search/search.component.html
    • src/app/pages/search/search.component.scss
    • src/app/pages/search/search.component.ts
  2. Frontend Routing
    • src/app/routes/app-features.routes.ts: Remove the lazy-loaded route for search.
  3. Frontend Service
    • src/app/shared/services/main.service.ts: Remove the search() method (only used by the search component).
  4. Backend Route
    • server.ts: Remove the /api/search endpoint and the import for API/search.ts.
  5. Backend API Logic

All code paths are strictly isolated to the search feature. No shared dependencies will break.

issues.display_title: Issue #1703: Refactor root layout to app-layouts and fix double layer .dash-main nesting
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Refactored the application layout structure to fix the double .dash-main class nesting issue (e.g., on the /:username and settings/ routes), while keeping the layout consistent with pages like /:username/info.

Changes Made

  • Simplified app.component.ts: Removed layout wrappers (Header, Footer, DashShell) from the root. The template now only contains <router-outlet>.
  • Centralized LayoutsComponent: Moved all global layouts (Header, Footer, DashShell, Alert Message) into <app-layouts>.
  • Fixed DashShellComponent: Converted app-dash-shell to use <ng-content> instead of <router-outlet>, decoupling it from routing.
  • Fixed ng-content Projection Bug: Used <ng-template #projectedContent> and ngTemplateOutlet to conditionally project the content inside either app-dash-shell or the standard layout-shell. This fixes the blank screen issue for pages without sidemenu by avoiding duplicate ng-content slots.
  • InformationComponent: Updated to use <app-layouts> properly.
